title: Signed double Roos exchange in the canonical left tensor model
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $T$. Use the coefficient category, left-Koszul completion $C$, unit $u$, strict Roos functor $\mathsf R$ and four row/column coordinates of [def-sp-power-torsion-limit-models]. Let $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to C$ have components $u_P$, and let $Q$ be any strict tower of unbounded complexes. Write $\mathrm{col}(Q)_j=\mathsf R_n(L_j\otimes Q_n)$. There is an isomorphism $\beta:\mathsf R_n C(Q_n)\cong\mathsf R_j\mathrm{col}(Q)_j$ which multiplies the $(p,q)$ coordinate, after interchanging the indices, by $(-1)^{pq}$. After applying $\mathsf R_n(\eta)$ and then $\beta$, the four coordinates are the outer unshifted coordinate followed by the Koszul inclusion, the outer shifted coordinate followed by that inclusion, zero, zero. There is also an isomorphism of strict $j$-towers $\gamma:(L_j\otimes\mathsf R_nQ_n)_j\cong\mathrm{col}(Q)$ such that $\mathsf R_n(\eta)\,\beta\,\mathsf R_j(\gamma^{-1})=u_{\mathsf R_nQ_n}$. This assertion assumes neither torsion nor completeness.

source.place: Completeness sentence, principal Koszul calculation and canonical quotient projections; Bhatt--Scholze, Lemmas 3.4.12 and 3.5.4--3.5.7.

proof.text: Apply signed_double_roos_tensor_exchange to the completed coefficient sheaf, using exact countable products. Identify its rearranged Roos functor on tower complexes with the shifted-cone functor of the models; identify its right tensor tower with the left tower by signed symmetry. The two projections of the Roos cone are preserved under the first identification, and tensor symmetry changes only the internal tensor degrees.

source.place: Completeness sentence, principal Koszul calculation and canonical quotient projections; Bhatt--Scholze, Lemmas 3.4.12 and 3.5.4--3.5.7.

proof.text: The generic interchange has signs 1,1,1,-1 on the four Roos coordinates. Conjugating by tensor symmetry on both sides leaves these four signs unchanged. Its augmentation clause gives the four specified coordinates, since the canonical unit has zero inner shifted coordinate. Its finite two-term Koszul tensor exchange gives gamma; its strict augmentation identity then gives exactly R(eta) beta R(gamma inverse)=u on the Roos complex.

theorem left_koszul_roos_exchange
    (η : 𝟭 (CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) ⟶ completion l E T)
    (hη : ∀ P, η.app P = unit l E T P)
    (Q : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) :
    ∃ (β : (roos l E T).obj (Q ⋙ completion l E T) ≅
        (roos l E T).obj (columns l E T Q)),
        (∀ (p q : Bool) (k : ℤ) (n j : ℕ),
          β.hom.f k ≫ columnCoordinate l E T Q p q k n j =
            if p && q then -rowCoordinate l E T Q p q k n j
            else rowCoordinate l E T Q p q k n j) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℤ) (n j : ℕ),
          (((roos l E T).map (Q.rightUnitor.inv ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft Q η)) ≫ β.hom).f k ≫
              columnCoordinate l E T Q false false k n j =
            coordinateZero l E T Q k n ≫
              (koszulRepresentativeAugmentation
                (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
                (Q.obj (op n)) (uniformizer l E T) j).f k ∧
          (((roos l E T).map (Q.rightUnitor.inv ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft Q η)) ≫ β.hom).f k ≫
              columnCoordinate l E T Q true false k n j =
            coordinateOne l E T Q k n ≫
              (koszulRepresentativeAugmentation
                (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
                (Q.obj (op n)) (uniformizer l E T) j).f (k - 1) ∧
          (((roos l E T).map (Q.rightUnitor.inv ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft Q η)) ≫ β.hom).f k ≫
              columnCoordinate l E T Q false true k n j = 0 ∧
          (((roos l E T).map (Q.rightUnitor.inv ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft Q η)) ≫ β.hom).f k ≫
              columnCoordinate l E T Q true true k n j = 0) ∧
        ∃ γ : (tensorTower l E T).obj ((roos l E T).obj Q) ≅ columns l E T Q,
          (roos l E T).map (Q.rightUnitor.inv ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft Q η) ≫
              β.hom ≫ (roos l E T).map γ.inv =
            unit l E T ((roos l E T).obj Q)
